hypothesis: W-R25's observed-only marker detector can confuse truly missing rows with legitimate observations that exactly match a missing-value encoding. Construct paired latent worlds with byte-identical observed input and opposite missingness truth; show a hard observability limit, not a retraining opportunity.
freeze: All generators, encodings, observation sites, seeds, balanced latent worlds, claims, classifications and budgets frozen before original first use. No threshold change, retry, holdout recycling or source repair after result.
data_source: Exact W-R20 affine/quadratic/xorshift 16x4 original generators, candidate offset+79 and time-varying noise amplitude3; preserved W-R25 learned weights only if used, never refitted. Both worlds share byte-identical base and observed candidate.
paired_worlds: For each seed, entity, generator, marker and site, create one observed candidate with the selected row replaced by the marker. Latent world A is an erasure whose real value was overwritten. Latent world B treats that identical row as a legitimate acquired observation, with no erasure. Both expose the exact same base, candidate and other supplied input features, and have opposite true hidden missingness status.
primary: Per marker/site/generator cell (18 cells) report observed-input identity checks, erasure recall, legitimate-observation false-positive rate, and balanced latent-mask classification accuracy for all arms. Store raw per-seed counts. Classification UNIDENTIFIABLE_WITHOUT_PROVENANCE if paired inputs are byte-identical in all 2592 pairs, opposite hidden labels, and each deterministic detector gives identical predictions across the two worlds. OTHERWISE_INVALID if any pairing/invariant differs. Any classifier on same observed bytes cannot achieve >50% balanced latent-mask accuracy under this exact paired protocol.
controls: Evidence generated from genuine prior raw generators but legitimate alias cases are deliberately constructed adversarially, not claimed to occur naturally at measured frequency
No privileged erasure bit, external mask channel, oracle or independent provenance passed to any detector
Equivalent observed candidate (including previous row and all four channels), same base for both worlds; optional model never refitted
No claim that downstream sequence-recognition accuracy is 50%; this study classifies latent missingness only
Exact parent/prereg/executor Git blobs, first-use archive and one full Go regression
claim_limit: Identifiability of synthetic missing-value markers, not general cognition or natural dropout prevalence.
